# Tech Tab

> A Chrome extension that replaces the new-tab page with a feed of Korean big-tech and startup engineering blog posts, auto-collected hourly. Free, no sign-up, no personal data collected.

## Links
- Landing page: https://junye0l.github.io/techtab/
- Install (Chrome Web Store): https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/kobpfgadkgconpdpdppekbioiebnoggc
- Source (GitHub): https://github.com/junye0l/techtab
- Privacy policy: https://junye0l.github.io/techtab/privacy.html

## What it does
- Aggregates ~21 Korean company engineering blog RSS feeds (NAVER, Kakao, Toss, Coupang, Daangn, Woowahan, and more) into one new-tab feed
- Pick which companies to follow, reorder columns by drag and drop, bookmark posts, mark as read, NEW badges for posts since last visit
- Korean and English UI; Korean post titles are machine-translated to English (DeepL)
- Dark/light mode, built-in Google search box

## Notes
- Tech Tab is an aggregator UI, not an original data source. It links to each publisher's post and does not host or republish article content.
- No account, login, or tracking. All user settings live in the browser's localStorage and never leave the device.
